doc: Boss script for Shingala (kind 514; Seagra in the Japanese effect names), run by each of the six linked pieces (monster handles 24 to 29) of the p01 boss. The pieces share a state machine through monster variables: each slams the ground with a dust ring, goes limp while its boss-c map part is shown, and recovers with an electric shock once hit or when its partner is far away. Each piece refills its life every frame and only counts hits.
